content.summary: The document is the 2021 ACC/AHA/SCAI Coronary Revascularization Guideline focusing on strategies for coronary revascularization aimed at reducing cardiovascular events. The guideline covers five-year outcomes in patients with left main disease, comparisons between percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), the effectiveness of medical therapy, and factors influencing treatment choices. It also highlights the analysis of major clinical trials like MASS II and ISCHEMIA, touching on outcomes related to surgical and angioplasty procedures.
